_comment: GPU catalog data (model lists are catalog data, not code). First matching rule wins. AMD discrete: RX (also RX Vega 56/64 and Vega M; RX Vega 10/11 Graphics is the APU of Ryzen 2000/3000 G and U and stays integrated), R9/R7/R5 with a model number, HD with four digits and no letter (HD 7660D is an APU), Radeon 540/550; APU names (Radeon Graphics, Vega 8 Graphics, 780M) stay integrated. Intel: Arc A and B cards and Arc Pro cards are discrete; Arc B3x0 (B370, B390) is the processor graphics of Core Ultra series 3 (Panther Lake) and stays integrated. ReBAR: NVIDIA rules need GeForce (Turing Quadro RTX cards have no ReBAR); workstation RTX cards fall to Unknown (no advice). AMD RX 5000: compatible per AMD claim GD-178. Legacy: F15 variant legacy: graphics the vendor no longer makes drivers for. NVIDIA: the Kepler desktop GeForce list (a_id 5204; Game Ready drivers ended October 2021, security updates September 2024, a_id 5202). AMD: the products AMD moved to its legacy support model, 'No additional driver releases are planned' (GPU-630): Radeon HD 5000 to 8000, R5/R7/R9 200 and 300 with their M versions, R7 M400, R9 Fury and Nano, and the APUs with Radeon R2 to R7 Graphics. Checked 2026-10-11.
